brief: Single-storey eclectic brick commercial building of the early twentieth century on a corner lot once owned by a local doctor: a square flat-roofed block with a three-quarter-round corner element, a brick parapet with stone coping, 1/1 windows, and matching stone-and-wood entrance porches on both street fronts, apparently built as a duplex commercial building; lawn and big trees around it.

facade.notes: 220 Pearl St (Ypsilanti MI, 1920s-30s): a one-storey brick corner building with a rounded corner (streamline), a fieldstone base, a small entry porch with wooden steps; on a lawn under big trees at the edge of downtown

why.note: the rounded streamlined corner of a 1930s commercial building
